summary: Constantin Sin from the Romanian Ministry of Agriculture said average GM soy yield rose 50 tonnes to 250 tonnes per km². Cultivated area rose from 396 km² in 2003 to 581 km² in 2004, mainly in Brăila, Călăraşi and Ialomiţa. The EU approved transgenic soy imports in 1996 and allowed GM animal-breeding products in 2004; producers are USA, Argentina and Brazil.
